convention: Continuous image px on the 2560x1440 master (same pixels as media/rooms/win-trust-2560.*); pixel (i,j) covers [i,i+1) x [j,j+1). Quads are TL, TR, BR, BL.
method: Pass A numeric: per-scanline strongest luminance step (parabolic sub-pixel) between surface and surround, least-squares line per edge with sigma clipping of occluded samples, corners = line intersections. Pass B visual: 3x nearest-neighbour crops with a 20 px grid and 5 px ticks, read by eye before Pass A; corners that disagreed by more than 2 px were re-read at 8x with a 1 px grid and the cause is given in notes (passBFirstRead keeps the original read). quad = mean of passA and passB; maxDiffPx = largest corner distance between them. Panel edges = lit area bounded by the black mullions and the dark frame lines above and below the glass. Occluders = objects in front of the surface, from a not-glass / not-screen mask inside each quad (merged within 2 px) or traced at 3x.

wt-panel-1.notes: Leftmost frosted panel, fully in frame (not cropped). Lit glass between the dark column/jamb (x~571-575) and mullion 1-2; ~25 px narrower than panels 3-5 (156 vs ~181 px); the 3 px lit sliver at x 567-570 is the column edge, excluded. Occluded: floor-plant leaves over the left edge (y~561-647), credenza plant over the bottom (x~593-705, y~628-717), bowl over the bottom-right corner (x>=706, y>=701) - BR corner is behind the bowl (edge-line intersection). Clear area ~x 580-725, y 296-555. Pass B first read took the credenza-lip highlight (y~719-720) as the bottom edge (2.9 px off); bottom re-read at 8x = 717.0.

wt-panel-2.notes: Lit glass between mullions at x~735 and x~901. Credenza bowl covers the bottom-left corner (x~735-777, y~701-717); BL corner is behind the bowl (edge-line intersection). Head-of-table chair back tops out at y~719, just below the bottom edge (not occluding). Left edge wobbles ~0.4 px rms in the render; first-read Pass B sat 1.6 px left of it (within tolerance).

wt-panel-3.notes: Lit glass x~906-1086. Pendant rod (x 908-915, warm white) hangs in front of the top-left, tip at y~318 (occluder recorded with a 2 px margin); the TL corner itself is visible just left of the rod. Bottom re-read at 8x (first read 2.2 px low).

wt-panel-4.notes: Lit glass x~1090-1272; no occluders - the cleanest panel. Right edge includes the 3 px lit side face of mullion 4-5 (x~1269-1271) and wobbles about 1 px in the render (1270.8-1272.0), fitted as a straight line. Bottom re-read at 8x (first read 2.2 px low).

wt-panel-5.notes: Lit glass x~1275-1458. Right edge = start of black mullion at x 1458; it includes the 4-5 px lit side face of mullion 5-6 (x~1453-1457), the glass itself ends at x~1453. Desk monitor covers the bottom-right (x~1363-1458, y~641-717); BR corner is behind the monitor (edge-line intersection). Pass B first read put the right edge inside the side face and the bottom on the credenza lip (2.9 px off); re-read at 8x.

wt-panel-6.notes: Rightmost panel: ~62 px narrower than panels 3-5 (120 px) and ends hard where the dark right-wall return starts at x~1581 - reads as cut off by the wall return (or ending at the corner). Monitor covers the bottom-left (x~1461-1512, y~641-716; BL corner behind it); desk plant covers the bottom-right (x~1517-1560, y~681-716). Top edge tilts 0.7 px across (soffit shading). Clear above y~640; best for a short line.

wt-monitor.notes: Dark screen + bezel (indistinguishable) against the lit glass of panels 5-6; ~144 x 75 px. Left and right edges lean ~0.025 px/px in the render (fitted as found). Bottom edge = where the screen meets the desk-chair back's top highlight (y~718.5); the chair back (occluder) hides any lower bezel, and on the left the screen bottom merges with the dark desk. Mullion 5-6 meets its top edge at x~1458-1461.

wt-binders.notes: Region for a glow + label anchor, not a writing surface. Corners = outer corners of the four corner folders: TL top-left of the far-left folder's cover, TR top-right of the far-right folder's cover, BR bottom-right of the near-right folder's base, BL bottom-left of the near-left folder's base; the sides follow the table's perspective. Encloses all six place folders (the middle-row outer corners sit on the side edges) and the document tray. The head-seat folder (x~839-920, y~778-784) and the pen-stand tip (y~769) sit just above the top edge. Occluder: tray + pen stand, which stand above the table plane. Label anchor = points['wt-binders-label'] (top-edge midpoint, clear of the tray).

wt-niche.notes: Lit walnut niche on the right wall, in perspective (right-wall VP ~(991, 659), see vanishingPoints). Quad = outer boundary of the niche's dark frame against the cladding: left = walnut to black reveal (x~1749.5), right = frame face to dark wall (x~1894.5), top = upper edge of the black top seam, bottom = lower edge of the black bottom seam. The lit opening sits 2-7 px inside this outline. Interior is not one plane (far side wall, back strip, LED ceiling, floor): use for glow/label; any text belongs on the wall plane. Occluder: black bowl on the niche floor. BR corner re-checked at 8x (1895.0, 797.2).

vanishingPoints.note: Meet of the niche frame top and bottom seam lines (right-wall horizontals); the back wall with the panels is frontal (panel edges vertical/horizontal to <0.01 px/px).
